lines.text: Candles flicker, shadows paint the wall
Your hands are tracing secrets I can’t recall
No one else has ever pulled me under quite like this
One look from you and I forget what “careful” is
The temperature is rising, can’t deny
The way your body calls me sets me alight
Burn through the dark, light me up inside
Let your love consume me, baby, take this ride
No hesitation, lose ourselves tonight
Burn through the dark till morning comes to light
Burn, burn, through the dark with me
Set my whole world free
Every breath you take against my skin feels like a prayer
We’re speaking in a language only lovers share
No more hiding feelings, no more playing pretend
Just you and me, this fire, and no need to defend
The temperature is rising, can’t deny
The way your body calls me sets me alight
Burn through the dark, light me up inside
Let your love consume me, baby, take this ride
No hesitation, lose ourselves tonight
Burn through the dark till morning comes to light
Burn, burn, through the dark with me
Set my whole world free
No walls between us, just heat and skin
Let the night erase where I end and you begin
Burn through the dark, light me up inside
Let your love consume me, baby, take this ride
No hesitation, lose ourselves tonight
Burn through the dark till morning comes to light
Burn, burn, through the dark with me
Set my whole world free
